frequency_question: How often does the MPC exercise its capability to raise the repo rate when macro conditions invite tightening within a defined window?
membership_rule: Includes all formally convened RBI MPC rate-setting meetings where a live tightening cycle was under consideration; excludes non-rate meetings or purely structural liquidity measures.

cases.name: RBI MPC Rate Hike Cycle 2022 (May - Intermeeting)

provenance_note: claims 54 cases from only 8 named (6.8x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 8 named tightening events across 54 total meetings; covers the entirety of the FIT regime.
known_gaps: Does not adjust for differing inflation prints or growth trajectories across individual meetings, treating all MPC meetings as potential opportunities for will-driven action.
skeleton: RBI tightening cycles since the formal adoption of the Flexible Inflation Targeting (FIT) framework in 2016, decomposed into active tightening meetings versus total rate-setting meetings.
multiplier: 8 tightening decisions out of 54 total MPC meetings held between October 2016 and September 2026.
validity_reason: The FIT mandate framework and structural voting behavior of the RBI MPC remain stable across medium-term appointments.
